build_DCEM_optimizer: build a DCEM optimizer instance with an Objective, custom n_sample, n_elite, and max_iterations for nonlinear optimization
run_DCEM_optimize: run the DCEM optimizer on an objective with unroll backward mode and verbose output to track convergence
review_DCEM_CEM_step: review the _CEM_step method that samples from a Normal distribution and updates mu and sigma using elite selection
refactor_DCEM_reset_sigma: refactor the reset_sigma method to initialize sigma with a custom init_sigma tensor for the optimizer
summarize_DCEM_mu_vec_to_dict: summarize the _mu_vec_to_dict method that splits a concatenated mu tensor into per-variable tensors by name
